verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a my.anydesk management console with address books and device management. It also documents managing users, roles and permissions, and the REST API can list the address books tied to a license. Nothing shows that access policies can be scoped per group or per address book, and the documentation is only index-level summaries. Missing for 10: explicit per-group or per-address-book access policy controls, detailed first-party docs on address-book sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies
